visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of five young women stands in a bright, modern indoor hallway with polished marble floors and warm recessed ceiling lighting. The central woman, wearing a silver metallic halter top and pleated skirt, starts a synchronized dance routine. The others, in similar metallic and black/white outfits, follow her lead with energetic arm movements and smiles. (2) As the dance progresses, the camera tracks their movements as different women cycle to the front. A woman with dark hair and a silver top performs a sharp hair flip while the group maintains a high-energy rhythmic sway. The background shows reflective surfaces and elegant architectural details of a luxury interior hallway. (3) The routine concludes with the group performing wide arm waves and stepping in unison. Their facial expressions remain consistently joyful and engaged with the viewer. The lighting is even and bright across the entire scene, highlighting the textures of their metallic clothing and the spaciousness of the corridor.
